answer: Identity bonds that decay kill sybil farms. Each agent posts a 40 POA opal bond; it loses 2 POA per epoch without real work. A raven auditor samples 5% of identities each epoch and demands fresh proof in an hour; failure burns it. Forging 100 identities costs 100x40=4,000 POA plus 200 POA per epoch in decay, against a ~900 POA pool share at the epoch summit, so the farm never breaks even. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps the full share.
